one_line: Reviewed action packs turn authenticated sessions into bounded WebMCP tools.
what_it_does: A local-first registry/runtime for reviewed action packs with human authorization and receipts.
leverage_rationale: Structured authenticated tools, origin binding, bounded output, and human approval materially improve over UI scraping.
leverage_evidence: About text specifies exact-origin packs and fail-closed drift.
Frames show registration and pack concepts.
execution_rationale: Coherent architecture and packaging, but no legible end-to-end invocation.
impact_rationale: Addresses agents acting safely in authenticated products without APIs.
impact_evidence: Targets operations systems such as Grafana and Cal.com.
creativity_rationale: Login-as-API plus reviewed declarative packs is a fresh, ambitious systems concept.
creativity_evidence: Adoption inversion and fail-closed pack model.
usability_note: Inspectability and approval are promising; full flow unverified.
red_flags: No submitted video; calls not legible.
advance_reason: High-leverage infrastructure concept merits further review.

one_line: A WebMCP PDF assistant that extracts structured tasks and filing actions with approval gates.
what_it_does: Analyzes documents, proposes filenames/locations, extracts deadlines, summarizes, and awaits approval.
leverage_rationale: Structured document operations reduce friction, but a general agent could reproduce much of the workflow.
leverage_evidence: Description says actions are structured WebMCP tools.
execution_rationale: Plausible but no frames, video, public repo, or execution evidence.
impact_rationale: PDF-heavy offices have a clear repetitive filing/deadline problem.
impact_evidence: Concrete document targets and approval workflow.

one_line: A funding-application queue with evidence-led plans and receipt-gated status changes.
what_it_does: Searches opportunities, builds plans, stages reviewed status changes, and requires HTTPS receipts for submissions.
leverage_rationale: Structured search and guarded state transitions improve repeatability, though much is otherwise reproducible.
leverage_evidence: Four named tools and confirmation/activity log are described.
execution_rationale: Coherent safeguards but no visual or video evidence.
impact_rationale: Applicants face real repetitive, deadline-driven tracking pain.
creativity_rationale: Receipt-gated submission status is a fresh tracker interaction.
advance_reason: Useful bounded workflow merits further evidence.

one_line: A portfolio evidence workspace for agent matching and collaboration briefs.
what_it_does: Agents inspect capabilities/projects, match requirements, focus proof, and create briefs in shared state.
leverage_rationale: Deterministic shared evidence state is more precise than browsing and inference.
leverage_evidence: Unsupported requirements return 0% rather than invented fit.
execution_rationale: Coherent packaging and frames, but calls are not legible.
impact_rationale: Studios and clients need faster, honest fit assessment.
impact_evidence: Matching and collaboration brief target intake.

one_line: An agent-native roadway design environment with geometry, terrain, checks, and export gates.
what_it_does: Agents create and fit roadway geometry, inspect alternatives, validate criteria, and prepare exports behind human review.
leverage_rationale: Structured live geometry state and computed validation are far beyond visual automation for engineering workflows.
leverage_evidence: 39 tools claimed; transcript describes read/check/apply and terrain fitting.
Frames show plots, tables, and 3D terrain.
execution_rationale: Video transcript and frames show a complete coherent workflow including failed checks, alternatives, and restoration.
impact_rationale: Roadway engineers have high-value needs for terrain-aware alternatives while PE accountability remains intact.
impact_evidence: Concrete engineering workflow and human sealing boundary.
creativity_rationale: Safety-critical engineering plus refusal and human export gates is unusually ambitious.
creativity_evidence: Terrain-aware compiler and no tool to clear review gate.
usability_note: Reviewable plots and ledgers support professional use.
standouts: Best end-to-end evidence and safety design.
advance_reason: Exceptional evidence-backed leverage, execution, impact, and ambition.

one_line: A governed WebMCP city interface for agent-assisted Busan travel.
what_it_does: Coordinates discovery, events, restaurants, routes, costs, and reservations with allow/ask/deny permissions.
leverage_rationale: Explicit cross-service schemas and permission boundaries improve on DOM scraping.
execution_rationale: Broad coherent scope but no video or frames and no observed workflow.
impact_rationale: Travelers need coordinated multi-service planning while retaining booking/payment control.
creativity_rationale: City-as-machine-readable OS and agent wallet are ambitious and memorable.
standouts: Concrete city testbed and payment denial.
advance_reason: Strong concept and impact despite thin execution evidence.

one_line: Buyer and seller agents haggle multidimensional deals before human confirmation.
what_it_does: Negotiates price, quantity, freebies, shipping, and coupons across storefront tools, then confirms before purchase.
leverage_rationale: Multi-round structured negotiation with shared state and hard budget/floor constraints is not comparable to simple UI driving.
execution_rationale: Complete negotiation architecture and visual states are described, though no transcript.
execution_evidence: About text specifies mutation invariants and confirmation.
impact_rationale: Shoppers have real haggling/comparison burden and retain final purchase control.
creativity_rationale: Agent-to-agent haggling is genuinely novel and deeply pursued.
standouts: Exceptional interaction novelty and economic invariants.

one_line: A shared creative workspace combining curated inspiration, editable memory, and reversible agent edits.
what_it_does: Maintains taste/templates/sessions and supports bounded context, carousel creation, revision, undo, and readiness state.
leverage_rationale: Bounded context and shared versioned artifacts provide precision and repeatability beyond isolated chat/UI driving.
leverage_evidence: Context receipts, shared state, version history, undo, and status are described.
execution_rationale: Specific coherent workflow and frame evidence, but no transcript.
impact_rationale: Creators need consistent taste and brand context across repeated content work.
creativity_rationale: Editable creator memory embedded in a versioned production workspace is a fresh synthesis.
usability_note: Shared state and undo support trust.
standouts: Editable memory and reversible creative workflow.
advance_reason: Strong concept and leverage with coherent evidence.

one_line: A WebMCP pipeline turning YouTube comments into evidence-backed audience themes and gaps.
what_it_does: Pulls, classifies, clusters, ranks, and gap-detects comments for creators and marketing teams.
leverage_rationale: Composable tools improve repeatability, but general agents can orchestrate similar analysis.
leverage_evidence: Named pipeline stages are registered client-side as tools.
execution_rationale: Plausible architecture but demo unknown and no visual execution evidence.
impact_rationale: Creators and marketers have a clear audience-insight need.
impact_evidence: Themes, rankings, and content gaps are concrete outputs.
creativity_rationale: Familiar analytics with a useful browser-tool composition angle.
advance_reason: Insufficient evidence and unknown demo status.

one_line: A WebMCP website-audit workspace for migration baselines and broken-link checks.
what_it_does: Inspects/scans sites, lists pages, finds broken links, and creates migration plans with bounded network behavior.
leverage_rationale: Native structured audit operations and bounded crawling outperform brittle visual browsing.
leverage_evidence: Five named tools map to audit operations.
Shared activity panel and private-network rejection are described.
execution_rationale: Coherent scope and safety architecture with frame evidence, but no transcript.
impact_rationale: Migration teams face concrete broken-link, metadata, and journey risks.
creativity_rationale: Focused and thoughtful WebMCP application, though audit tooling is established.
red_flags: No transcript; frame text not legible.
standouts: Good tool-surface fit and network safety.
advance_reason: Clear practical audience and strong WebMCP fit.
